thumb_dorsal.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: an individual macro anatomy reference for refining an existing Blender game character's finger. Input image is only a character skin-tone/proportion reference. Produce ONE single photoreal macro photograph, ONE individual intact adult digit, ONE view only, centered vertical, fingertip upward, isolated on matte charcoal gray. The digit stays attached to its hand beyond the bottom crop; show the complete exposed digit down to a small black fingerless glove edge. No other fingers or hands in frame, no collage, panels, inset, labels, text or watermark. Preserve the existing warm light-medium skin tone and slender proportions; do not make a childlike or swollen digit. Extremely detailed believable live skin: tapered phalanges, restrained knuckle volume, soft fingertip pad, asymmetric small joint creases and fine branching skin microrelief. Neutral studio macro photography, soft broad upper-left raking light with fill, sharp focus across the whole digit, no oily shine. Keep anatomy plausible, no injuries, cracks, dirt, jewelry, severed ends or exaggerated wrinkles.
Subject: THUMB. It is naturally shorter and broader than the other digits, with one main exposed interphalangeal joint. Broad short natural nail.
View: straight-on DORSAL / NAIL SIDE, nail plate fully visible, no palmar view. Nail has a close-fitting cuticle, thin pale free edge, pink nail bed, subtle lunula and very fine longitudinal ridges. Convincing softly sculpted PIP/DIP knuckles with a few curved transverse creases and tiny branching wrinkles; avoid deep cuts or uniformly repeated parallel rings.
